# apple_app_store_version_localization_search_keyword (Resource)

Links one search keyword to an App Store version localization. App Store Connect offers the keywords for each platform and locale; list them with `data.apple_app_search_keywords`. Changes need the version to be editable. Destroying the resource removes the keyword. Import it with `<localization_id>/<keyword_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_app_search_keywords" "en_us" {
  app_id   = data.apple_app.example.id
  platform = "IOS"
  locale   = "en-US"
}

resource "apple_app_store_version_localization_search_keyword" "en_us" {
  for_each        = data.apple_app_search_keywords.en_us.ids
  localization_id = apple_app_store_version_localization.en_us.id
  keyword_id      = each.key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `keyword_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the search keyword.
- `localization_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the version localization, e.g. `apple_app_store_version_localization.en_us.id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_app_store_version_localization_search_keyword.en_us["9876543210"]
  identity = {
    localization_id = "1234567890"
    keyword_id      = "9876543210"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `keyword_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the search keyword.
- `localization_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the version localization.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import 'apple_app_store_version_localization_search_keyword.en_us["9876543210"]' 1234567890/9876543210
```
